description: This Swift source file defines the NodeDisplayName enum with static methods and properties to manage and resolve display names for devices in an iOS environment, based on device type and existing names.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if the provided name is a generic device name.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Provides a default device name based on the interface idiom (phone or pad).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Determines the appropriate display name based on existing name, device name, and interface idiom.

methods.name: normalizedDeviceName
methods.description: Normalizes the device name if it contains common device identifiers like 'iPhone' or 'iPad'.
